warning a11y_click_events_have_key_events 1:1-3:7 Visible, non-interactive element `<div>` with a click event must be accompanied by a keyboard event handler. Consider whether an interactive element such as `<button type="button">` or `<a>` might be more appropriate
    https://svelte.dev/e/a11y_click_events_have_key_events
warning a11y_no_static_element_interactions 1:1-3:7 `<div>` with a click handler must have an ARIA role
    https://svelte.dev/e/a11y_no_static_element_interactions
warning event_directive_deprecated 1:6-1:14 Using `on:click` to listen to the click event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onclick` instead
    https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated
warning slot_element_deprecated 2:5-2:13 Using `<slot>` to render parent content is deprecated. Use `{@render ...}` tags instead
    https://svelte.dev/e/slot_element_deprecated
